title: Ofgem price cap categories, Oct-Dec 2026 (cap model v1.31)
source: https://www.ofgem.gov.uk/sites/default/files/2026-08/Default-tariff-cap-level-v1.31.xlsx; https://www.ofgem.gov.uk/sites/default/files/2026-08/Annex-2-wholesale-cost-allowance-methodology-v1.30_data_removed-2.xlsx; https://www.ofgem.gov.uk/sites/default/files/2026-08/Annex-4-policy-cost-allowance-methodology-v1.25.xlsx; Annex 3 network cost allowance (TNUoS, DUoS, BSUoS)
note: Categories as in the cap model's calculation sheets (ElecSingle_*): Wholesale = DF (direct fuel, which carries the CfD, shaping, hedging and losses allowances of Annex 2) and CM; Policy costs = PC (Annex 4); Network costs = NC (Annex 3, including BSUoS); Operating costs, EBIT and Headroom. Ofgem shows the last three separately; the bill's supplier line bundles them, so they are one group here. Lines outside the cap are placed by the levy that would recover them. A new cap release that moves a line adds a new vintage; it never edits an old one.
